property_summary: The reference C enforces that after any successful fallback call, every further fallback call made at the same block.timestamp reverts (timestamp must be strictly greater); the mutant relaxes this to >=, letting a second call in the same timestamp succeed.
change_summary: Relax the timestamp check from strictly greater to greater-or-equal, allowing a second call in the same timestamp.
